name: Degenerate-Logarithm Kinetic with Spatial-Nonlocal F+ Decoupled from Screened Frame
claimed_mechanism: This candidate features a degenerate scalar $\chi$ whose kinetic term is logarithmically suppressed ($\log(1+y)$) but strictly second-class, ensuring zero physical DOF for the MOND carrier while generating the exact $\nabla \cdot [\mu(y) \nabla \Phi]$ dynamics. The kinetic normalization of the auxiliary is controlled by an independent spatial nonlocal elliptic operator $f(-D^2/a_0^2)$ rather than the $e^{-y}$ screening factor. This structural decoupling directly attacks the P7 collision by ensuring that the screened preferred-frame response ($\alpha_{PF} \propto e^{-y}$) does not simultaneously zero out the propagating-mode kinetic normalization.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the MOND dynamics recover the correct $g_{dyn} = \sqrt{g_N a_0}$ behavior via the auxiliary $\chi = \mu(y)$. Lensing is corrected by the screened preferred-frame carrier $u_\mu$, which provides the necessary $O(\epsilon^2)$ stress to boost $\Psi$ to $\Phi$, bypassing the local pincer because the $u_\mu$ sector is coupled to the spatially nonlocal MOND operator. The $e^{-y}$ factor screens the PPN parameters $\alpha_1, \alpha_2$ to zero in the solar system, while the independent elliptic kernel keeps the scalar kinetic term finite and non-ghostly.
inequivalence_argument: This is genuinely inequivalent to DC-001 (local frameless) because it explicitly includes a preferred-frame vector $u_\mu$ coupled to the spatially nonlocal MOND operator. It avoids DC-003 (lapse-weighted) by strictly forbidding $N$-weighted MOND couplings. It avoids DC-012 (frameless localized) because the frame is NOT frameless; the frame provides the lensing fix. It avoids P7 because the kinetic normalization of the MOND sector is governed by the independent elliptic operator $f(-D^2/a_0^2)$, not by the $e^{-y}$ screening factor which only controls the PPN-visible frame couplings.
